body.name: intrinsic normalized parameter carrier
body.construction: Index every primitive natural response table and latent-root law appearing in the stored normalized syntax, tag each natural row as active or dormant, and take their product of probability simplices to obtain \(\Lambda_H\). Construct \(g_H\) from shared-coordinate and known-gate syntax, construct \(o_H^N\), \(s_H^N\), and \(t_{a,H}^N\) by finite recursive summation, and define \(\mathcal I_H\) by the displayed gate, exact-support, and strict admissible-cell constraints, without referring to \(\nu_H(\Theta_H)\).
